title: Dangerous DANA i Bug - wrong IOB after Bolus delivery (could lead to overdosing)
symptom: After initiating a bolus of 5 iE, the delivery went through, but sometimes an error message appears and the IOB on the frontpage remains at the same level as before the bolus, as if the bolus was not delivered. It stays that way until another bolus is delivered. The issue occurs often and may lead to dangerous situations.
cause: The phone lost the connection to the pump, so AAPS could not get the information about the issued bolus. The history loadable from the Dana tab is not used for bolus data.
fix: Press the BT icon to force a new connection to the Dana pump, which will read the history and update IOB.
evidence_quote: you must press BT icon to force new connection to dana pump
